question: In which of the following months is the ‘Valvil Ori Vizha’ festival of Tamil Nadu celebrated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**August.**__

__
 
• **Val Vil Ori Festival (vizha)** celebrated in a grand manner in **Kollihills during the month of August (17th and 18th of Adi in Tamil Month) every year.**
 
• School students from various parts will participate in** archery competition** held during Val Vil Ori Vizha.
